items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: The Dorsey Brothers orchestra kept adding and dropping people... You did play with the Dorsey Brothers Concert Orchestra. Yes, I think maybe you did. Fuzzy Farrar, Phil Napoleon, Glenn Miller, Eddie Lang.

ctx.x: Maybe you weren't. Because the people kept coming and going. The Dorsey Brothers orchestra kept adding and dropping people. Let me see. You did play with the Dorsey Brothers Concert Orchestra. Yes, I think maybe you did. Fuzzy Farrar, Phil Napoleon, Glenn Miller, Eddie Lang. You made 'Lover Come Back To Me', part one and part two. Do you remember that record? Do you remember that? You don't remember that. 'Lover Come Back To Me.'
